subject: Starter Fund cohort credits — structuring a program-level offer
messages:
From: Carla Mendes <carla@starterfund.org>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vishal Rao <vishal@founderhub.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + Starter Fund cohort credits?

Hi Markus —

Quick intro: I run partnerships for Starter Fund (accelerator for seed-stage B2B founders). We’ve been recommending Redwood for several portfolio teams and are exploring a program-level arrangement so every accelerator company can get runway credits and predictable pricing as they build.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a cohort offer that includes a promotional credits package (one-time non-refundable credit, plus a small recurring discount for 6 months) with simpler eligibility (proof of cohort membership)? Two specifics we get asked a lot:
- Can unused credits roll forward within the same company if they don’t use the full amount in month 1?
- Is there a limit per company or per cohort? (e.g., 50k tokens / company or 500k tokens / cohort)

We’re not looking for a permanent discount — more of a curated startup bundle that reduces friction during the first 6 months. Happy to jump on a quick call or accept a draft offer we can share with founders.

Thanks — and cc’d Vishal who manages integration with our demo day stack.

—Carla
Carla Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Starter Fund
carla@starterfund.org

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Carla Mendes <carla@starterfund.org>
Cc: Vishal Rao <vishal@founderhub.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Starter Fund cohort credits?

Carla — great to meet you over email. Thanks for championing Redwood with your founders. I’m excited to explore a formalized cohort bundle. A few notes up-front to set expectations:

1) Promo credit + short-term discount is doable — we run similar programs with other accelerators. Typical structure we’ve offered: a one-time promo credit (applied to the account upon verification) plus a 10–25% discounted rate for the first 3–6 months.

2) Roll-forward: we prefer not to have indefinite rollovers because of accounting and abuse vectors, but we can allow credit carry-forward within a 3-month window for the same legal entity (proof required).

3) Limits: we can do per-company caps (we usually price by cohort size and exposure). As a strawman: 75k tokens credit per company + an optional cohort pool of 250k tokens that Starter Fund can allocate to early winners.

4) Verification: simplest path is a one-line cohort verification email from you (cc to us) or an automated CSV upload.

If that aligns I’ll draft a short program sheet (promo terms, verification process, and a HubSpot track) and run it by our Partnerships/PriceOps team.

Would you be available for a 25-min call Wednesday (AEST-friendly) or Thursday morning (PDT)? I’ll include a short proposal attachment after internal review.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Starter Fund cohort credits — proposal ask (need quick approval)

Folks — forwarding Carla’s note. Starter Fund wants a cohort-level arrangement (promo credits + short discount window). They’ve recommended us frequently; cohort size usually 8–12 seed B2B companies.

Proposed commercial:
- 75k token one-time credit per company (applied on new account activation after verification).
- 15% off list for 3 months post-activation.
- A discretionary cohort pool of 250k tokens controlled by Starter Fund for top demos (optional).
- Credits roll-forward within 3 months for the same legal entity only. No transfers across companies.

Questions / asks:
1) Marissa — is 75k promo credit per company within Promo budget for partner programs? If not, what cap would you suggest?
2) Rishi — this will likely be a low-dollar, high-volume motion; can we add a HubSpot playbook and a simple verification webhook? Also want to confirm whether legal needs a special addendum or if the standard Promo Terms PDF covers it.

I’ve attached a barebones program sheet (StarterFund_Program_Proposal.xlsx) and a template of promo terms (Redwood_Promo_Terms_v1.pdf). Please reply with thumbs up / changes so I can send a client-facing proposal.

Thanks —MK

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vishal Rao <vishal@founderhub.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Starter Fund — cohort offer and next steps

Carla / Vishal — thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals. Below is the offer Redwood can extend to Starter Fund portfolio companies. This is written for you to share directly with founders.

Offer (per qualifying company)
- One-time promo credit: 75,000 tokens (applied on account creation after cohort verification).
- Discount: 15% off our hosted API list rates for 3 months following first activation (applies to generation tokens only).
- Cohort pool: Starter Fund may request up to 250,000 tokens per cohort for discretionary awards (we’ll issue these as single-use promo codes).
- Credit rollover: unused promo credit may be carried forward for up to 3 months for the same legal entity. No credit splitting or transfer allowed.
- Eligibility: founder must provide a verification email from Starter Fund (from a verified starterfund.org address) or a simple CSV upload to our onboarding portal.
- Limits: max 75k promo credit per company; Redwood reserves the right to audit for misuse.

Operational items / next steps
1) I’ll generate a cohort agreement template and promo codes. I’ve created a HubSpot playbook to track activations (link below).
2) Legal: the standard promo terms cover this; we’ll prepare a two-paragraph addendum clarifying cohort pool controls — I’ve cc’d Marissa and Rishi for signature routing.
3) Integrations: Vishal — we can provide an API endpoint for CSV verification or accept a signed verification email. If you want automatic provisioning we’ll need a simple webhook integration (estimate: 1–2 engineering days).

Attachments: StarterFund_Program_Proposal.xlsx (implementation sheet), Redwood_Promo_Terms_v1.pdf (promo/legal summary).

If that matches your expectation please confirm and I’ll issue a pilot batch of promo codes for your next cohort (ETA: 2 business days after confirmation).

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
